2. Drag-and-drop your banner image onto the Screen Ad position with a width of 768px and a width of 960px.

4. Click Save.

5. Click on the gear icon at the top right corner of the admin area and navigate to Settins > Banners.
6. Click on the banner you want to edit.
7. In the sidebar, hover over Settings and Click Add Block.
8. Under Switch to Designer Builder Mode, click Yes.
